title: Crowd Formation / Fracture Reveals Agency
observed_structure: a group establishes a repeated formation or movement rule
one body changes timing, direction, or spacing
the deviation alters the group rather than remaining decorative
cultural_scope: general group-formation structure; project context must identify the institution and stakes
misuse_risks: perfect formation equated automatically with oppression
transferable_structure: a repeated group rule becomes visible when one participant deviates and forces the collective to respond
non_transferable_surface: copying specific military, ritual, labor, or dance formations without contextual provenance
